fact: The seventh edition of the Anuario Estadistico de Guinea Ecuatorial 2024 (INEGE, data to 2023, press note of 8 November 2024) draws on ministerial administrative records and shows vital events from the health information system, education, social security (INSESO) and justice tables.
title: ANUARIO ESTADÍSTICO DE GUINEA ECUATORIAL 2024
publisher: Instituto Nacional de Estadística de Guinea Ecuatorial (INEGE)
